chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Thal'abah ibn Maymun, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'When a faction of Satan touches them, they become mindful, then they see.'
He said: 'It is the servant who intends the sin, then he becomes mindful, then he withholds; that is His Words:
they become mindful, then they see.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says 'they become mindful, then they see' after being touched by Satan?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the mechanism of *Tadhakkur* (remembrance) as the pivotal moment of spiritual awakening where a believer, tempted by Satan, halts their sin through conscious awareness. This interpretation highlights the Shia emphasis on the internal struggle (*Jihad al-Nafs*) and the immediate efficacy of divine remembrance in restoring clarity (*Mubsiroon*) before the sin is fully actualized. It serves as a foundational text for understanding repentance not merely as post-facto regret, but as a real-time cognitive shift that prevents transgression.
